_doc: Look and feel of Denisse's own windows: the floating orb (floating_orb.py) and the hover dock under it (orb_controls.py), loaded by ui_theme.py. Edit ui_theme.json, not this file: this one holds the shipped defaults, and any value in ui_theme.json that is missing or invalid is logged and replaced by its default here. Colours are #rrggbb. Sizes are logical pixels (multiplied by the screen's DPI scale). Times say their unit in the key name. Read once at start-up.

palette._doc: Colours shared across windows. reminder_card.py and study_mode.py take the orb's colours from floating_orb, which takes them from here.

fonts._doc: family is used when the caller doesn't pass one (tray.py passes its own FONT_FAMILY).

orb._doc: The orb widget. Window side = size + 2 * glow_pad.

core._doc: Glossy sphere. Radius = half the core * (radius_rest + radius_swing * breath); keep rest + swing <= 1 or the core clips. The highlight sits up-left of centre by highlight_dx/dy radii, highlight_radius radii across.

glow._doc: Soft halo: radius_frac of the core's diameter, alpha alpha_rest + alpha_swing * breath (0-255), blurred by blur of the frame size.

ring._doc: The rotating targeting ring: arcs in degrees from the ring's current angle; colour names a palette entry.

animation._doc: tick_ms is the frame timer; one breath is breath_frames ticks, one ring turn 360 / ring_deg_per_tick ticks. speed is frames advanced per tick for each mood (default for any other). motion moves the orb inside its window by mood: kind is shake (x = amplitude * sin(t * rate)), bounce (y = -amplitude * |sin(t * rate)|), orbit (a circle of radius amplitude), lift (y = -amplitude), bob (y = amplitude * sin(t * rate)) or still.

interaction._doc: Dragging the orb and how long each little reaction lasts.

bubble._doc: The orb's 'here's what I heard' speech bubble.

dock._doc: Hover dock under the orb. buttons run left to right; action is which of tray's callbacks it calls (chat, voice, reminders), icon which glyph it draws (chat, mic, bell). The button whose action is voice lights up while wake-word listening is on.
dock.title: Denisse controls

layout._doc: Logical px. Button i is centred at first_x + i * pitch; it spans button_top..height - button_top and half_width either side.
